  - **Use “we” instead of “you”** - use collective pronouns to promote a sense of teamwork and shared purpose 
    - Even if it’s really just about stuff one person is going to do
    - Source: [team-building slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1qJDpFdS42kF5pcrbmxm1xFWzNoNamVrnMFelwAOh73Q/edit#slide=id.gddb97543ad_3_13), by Naomi Alterman for SnowEx Hackweek.
